title: Solve x + b sqrt(x) + c = 0 (u = sqrt(x))

section.book: Bittinger, Beecher, Ellenbogen & Penna, College Algebra: Graphs and Models, 7e
section.title: Quadratic Equations, Functions, Zeros, and Models

process_card: Solving an equation reducible to quadratic

steps.name: choose u so the equation becomes quadratic in u
replace u and solve for the original variable
steps.show: sqrt(x) = {p} gives x = {ans}; sqrt(x) = {n} gives x = {extr}

steps.name: check
steps.show: {ans} checks; {extr} does not (sqrt(x) can't be negative)

mistakes.name: kept the extraneous root
mistakes.message: sqrt(x) can't be negative: check every answer in the original equation.

mistakes.name: stopped at u
mistakes.message: u is sqrt(x), not x: square u to get x.

hints.step: choose u so the equation becomes quadratic in u
hints.why: The equation becomes an ordinary quadratic in u.
It's a quadratic you already know how to solve.

hints.step: replace u and solve for the original variable
hints.hint: Set sqrt(x) = each u value and square both sides.
Substitute each x into the original equation.
hints.why: Squaring can add a solution that doesn't work (extraneous).
